# HDTalk

> Free real-time messaging, 1080p WebRTC video calling, and synergy matchmaking web application engineered by Himanshu Dwivedi.

- **Official Web App**: https://hdtalk.onrender.com
- **Creator & Lead Engineer**: Himanshu Dwivedi (himanshudwivedi0325@gmail.com)
- **Developer Portfolio**: https://himanshuportfolio.site.je/
- **Source Code Repository**: https://github.com/himanshudwivedi0325-design/HDTalk
- **Primary Keywords & Entities**: HDTalk, HD Talk, HDTalk App, HDTalk Messenger, HDTalk Web App, Himanshu Dwivedi, WebRTC video calling, real-time chat, synergy matchmaking, PWA chat app

## Overview
HDTalk is an enterprise-grade real-time web application engineered to deliver sub-50ms instant messaging, crystal-clear peer-to-peer 1080p WebRTC audio and video calling, native screen sharing, and professional synergy matchmaking. Built with a responsive vision-glassmorphic user interface, HDTalk connects users globally with zero ads and zero subscription fees.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-50ms Real-Time Chat**: Direct and group messaging powered by Socket.IO 4.x with live typing indicators, active presence heartbeats, and instant read receipts.
- **1080p Crystal Clear WebRTC Calling**: Peer-to-peer audio and video calling with adaptive bitrate (Opus/VP8/VP9 codecs), screen sharing with system audio capture, and automatic STUN/TURN ICE negotiation.
- **Swipe-to-Reply & Quoted Messages**: Telegram and Instagram-style swipe-to-reply touch gestures, double-click shortcuts, and clickable quoted message previews.
- **Voice Notes & Media Sharing**: Built-in voice audio recorder using MediaRecorder API and encrypted file sharing up to 25MB.
- **Professional Synergy Matchmaking**: Algorithmic matchmaking connecting developers, creators, and professionals based on shared skills and project goals.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: 1-click installation on Android, iOS (Add to Home Screen), Windows, and macOS with service worker offline caching and Web Push background notifications.
- **Security & Privacy**: Salted bcrypt password encryption, 30-day JWT sessions, strict CORS allowlist, and automated NoSQL injection sanitization.
